ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface with a near-zero global contrast ratio; high-intensity pixels are limited to extraneous water spray and light reflection.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 45 degrees relative to the lobal axes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge featuring high-amplitude serrations and notches on the left lobe, and smaller, higher-frequency jagged peaks on the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric concavity along the posterior boundary of both lobes, sweeping upward toward the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized cluster of high-contrast, brownish-white pixel groups attached to the far right tip of the fluke.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple deep, irregular notches and missing segments along the trailing edge of the left lobe, indicating structural tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive biological colonization (barnacles) on the distal right tip, protruding from the geometric boundary of the fluke.
